fields.label: Use Spatially-Varying Value
fields.help: Check this box to use values that vary between parcels.

fields.label: Use Custom File
fields.help: Check this box to load spatially-varying values from a custom file. Uncheck this box to load spatially-varying values from the default file.

fields.label: File for Spatially-Varying Values
fields.help: Indicate the file of spatially-varying values.

fields.label: Field Name for Spatially-Varying Values
fields.help: Indicate the field name for the spatially-varying values.

fields.label: Static Value
fields.help: Enter a single value to use throughout your model run.
